thread:
sam: heads up — prod quant inference path OOMing in eu-west1 dedicated pool, seeing elevated 5xx and KV cache thrash since 01:18 UTC. Rolling revert candidate v3.1.4-quant-revert. Need expedited approval to skip staged canary and push hotfix.

jordan: blast radius? which customers/pools affected?

sam: primarily dedicated pools for embeddings/long-context clients, ~8% of traffic in eu-west1, spike correlates with long sequences > 8k tokens. No DB changes.

sre-bot: alert: embeddings-service eu-west1 — mem usage 92% avg across affected hosts, 5xx rate 12% (1m).

ada: I'm okay skipping canary. It's a straight revert to the prior quant kernels we shipped two weeks ago. Approve for expedited deploy. :thumbsup:

maria: add release note line and tag CS/Security. No schema/migration risk.

sam: Deploy command I'm going to run: `releasebot deploy --env eu-west1 --version v3.1.4 --skip-canary --reason "quant OOM hotpath"`

rohit: tagging infra-oncall for eu-west1 to watch networking and autoscaler. @infra-oncall

jordan: rollback criteria proposed: if 5xx rate > 3% for 5m OR memory > 88% on >=2 nodes for 3m -> immediate rollback. Agree?

sre-bot: preflight checks: smoke requests OK from health-check pool, latency within 95th baseline. Running KV-cache warmup now.

releasebot: deploy job #4821 kicked off by sam -> eu-west1 / v3.1.4 (skip-canary=true). Stages: drain old, replace, verify.

sam: copying release note: "fix: revert quant kernels causing OOM under long-context workloads (v3.1.4)" — will paste into release notes after deploy.

releasebot: stage 1 complete: 1/3 hosts updated. Health checks green.

jordan: monitoring graphs up — error rate trending down. Good so far.

releasebot: stage 3 complete: 3/3 hosts updated. Traffic switched. Verification: 5xx rate down to 0.6%, mem usage avg 70%.

maria: filing short KB/ops note + release notes now. CC: support-team.

sam: thanks all. Will keep an eye and open a brief postmortem if we see recurrence. Great quick reactions. :rocket:
